title: Claude Code plugin.json, the fields tk writes
description: Read 27 Oct 2026 from https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference (redirects to the manifest reference). name is the only required key: non-empty, no spaces, @, :, path separators, control or bidi characters; kebab-case. Unknown top-level keys are stripped with a warning. metadata is free-form and Claude Code does not read it (v2.1.222+): tk's library data goes there. Component paths start with ./ and stay inside the plugin root. Claude Code publishes no JSON Schema URL for this file (not found); `claude plugin validate` is the authoritative check and runs in the box test.
